page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c16g1.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance belonging to the ecs.gn5i family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and runs on the KVM hypervisor. The instance features 16 dedicated virtual CPUs (vCPUs) paired with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core.

Acceleration is provided by a single integrated NVIDIA P4 GPU equipped with 8 GB of video RAM (VRAM). This instance does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the inclusion of a dedicated NVIDIA P4 GPU makes this instance a specialized option for workloads requiring hardware acceleration without the overhead of larger, high-end GPU models. It is suitable for workloads such as entry-level deep learning inference, video transcoding, and GPU-accelerated general-purpose computing.
